Kai (Marketing): Quick sync — aiming to publish Wed 2026-06-10 09:00 PT. Need final one-line changelog, docs anchor, webinar RSVP, and a hero benchmark stat for the post. Can eng confirm canary plan? :wave:
Ruth (Eng): We can run canary. Which model name should we call out? We used rwd-infer-v3-beta in staging. Any embargo rules?
Kai (Marketing): Use rwd-infer-v3-beta. Embargo lift: 2026-06-10 09:00 PT. Changelog draft at https://internal.redwood/changelog/PR-599 — please paste final one-liner + 2 bullets here. No quantization notes public.
Ben (Docs): I'll create /docs/releases/2026-06-10 and add anchor /docs/releases/2026-06-10#orbit-broadcast. Will add migration note for routing flags. ETA EOD today.
Mina (Growth): RSVP (staging): https://events.redwood.ai/launch-june?utm_campaign=orbit_broadcast. I'll swap to prod once Ben posts final doc URL. Need a 1-line speaker blurb.
Ruth (Eng): Perf snapshot: p50 gen 66ms (prev 84ms), p95 285ms (prev 370ms). Token cost ~11% lower. CSV uploaded to PR. Is that OK for marketing copy?
Kai (Marketing): We'll say "~20% latency improvement on common prompts and lower per-token compute cost" — marketing-safe. Eng sign-off?
Ruth (Eng): Good to go on phrasing. Recommend rollout: 10% T+0, 40% T+25m, 100% T+2h. Ops, please confirm rollback thresholds.
Ariel (Ops): OK on ramp. Rollback triggers: error rate >1% for 5m OR sustained p50 >2x baseline for 10m. We'll monitor and post to #eng-sre.
announce-bot: Canary schedule queued: 10% -> 1771235160 (T+6m), 40% -> 1771236120 (T+26m), 100% -> 1771239960 (T+1h). Healthchecks enabled. :robot_face:
Mina (Growth): Speaker blurb: "Join Redwood engineers for a demo of faster inference and new routing controls." CTA: "Reserve your spot  limited seats."
Ben (Docs): Adding changelog one-liner: "Routing improvements and KV-cache fixes to speed hosted inference and lower cost." Two bullets added to docs. Will drop final URL here when ready.
Ruth (Eng): I'll push final changelog commit by 15:30 PT and link it here.
Kai (Marketing): Thanks all — will include model name and bench callout in hero. Tagging @Ruth @Ben @Ariel @Mina. If anything changes post here. :thumbsup:
